thread:
devops-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: elevated 5xx and segfaults on inference-prod (us-east-1). Alerts triggered by 5xx-rate > 6% and replica restarts. Auto-page to SRE oncall.

sre-oncall: Ack, I'm on it. Noted spike around 11:34 UTC. Looking for patterns across model-runners.

maya: Seeing continuous OOM+SIGSEGV on model-runner-2 pods (node gpu-03). Logs show `cudaSegfault` then process exit.

sre-oncall: Copy. Pasting recent container logs (tail):
```
[11:33:42] model-runner: INFO starting request id=be3a
[11:33:45] model-runner: ERROR runtime panic: segfault at 0x0
[11:33:45] kernel: gpu 0: watchdog reset
[11:33:46] kubelet: Pod model-runner-2 crashed with OOMKilled
```

kiran: Gateway showing timeouts too — upstreams failing fast. Canary traffic 10% -> 100% before spike. Did a recent rollout go out?

ryan: Yes, there was a quantized-attention build pushed ~11:10 by infra-ci. Rollout status looked green until now.

sre-oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) Pause rollout, 2) Shift traffic to fallback model-v1 (non-quant) 3) Evict affected node gpu-03 from scheduler, 4) Collect core dumps + nvcrash logs, 5) Engage ML infra.

maya: Executed `kubectl rollout pause deployment/model-runner`. Took it to paused state.

kiran: Routing change in progress — redirecting traffic of model-route /v1/generate to model-v1-fallback. ETA ~30s.

sre-oncall: Scaling up model-v1-fallback to handle extra load: `hpa scale --min=4 --max=12` applied.

ryan: Eviction started for node gpu-03, draining pods so other nodes can pick up. Placing node into maintenance: `kubectl cordon gpu-03`.

customer-success: Heads up — we're seeing ~8% request failures for some customers. Which tenant cohorts impacted?

maya: Impacted tenants appear to be high-latency streaming users and a couple of dedicated Dedicated accounts pinned to us-east-1. I'll compile a short impact summary.

sre-oncall: Collecting metrics: 5xx spike started at 11:33:40, peaked at 11:35. CPU/GPU thermal events correlate with node.

ryan: Pulling nvcrash artifacts and core dumps now to S3: `s3://redwood-incidents/3543216789/`. Upload should complete in ~5m.

kiran: Quick triage note: failure mode is consistent with a kernel-level GPU reset during attention kernel execution with quantized weights. Non-quant path hasn't shown segfaults so far.

sre-oncall: Good, that suggests a regression in quant kernels. Next: revert quantized kernel or pin previous model image for rollout.

maya: Started rolling back the image tag to model-runner:2026-02-17. Will monitor.

customer-success: Can we get a short blurb for customers? "We observed increased 5xx and timeouts caused by GPU driver resets on a small subset of inference nodes. Traffic has been routed to fallback models and node maintenance is underway. We're investigating root cause and will update in 30m." Is that ok?

sre-oncall: Yes, go ahead and send. Add note that no data loss expected and teams on it 24/7.

ryan: FYI core dump analysis hint: stack shows failure in `quant_attention::compute_kv()` within fused CUDA kernel.

kiran: Adding ML infra and runtime leads: @maya @ryan please join debug call. Starting bridge in #incident-bridge-3543216789.

sre-oncall: After rollback traffic stabilizing: 5xx down to baseline ~0.6% and no new segfaults on other nodes. Keeping node cordoned pending investigation.

customer-success: Sent customer notification with the blurb. A few customers replied asking for ETA; told them approx 60-90m for full validation.

maya: We have core dumps + nvlogs uploaded. Will triage with ML leads and open a follow-up issue against quant-kernel repo.

devops-bot: Handoff reminder — oncall swap scheduled at 12:00 UTC. @sre-oncall please provide state for incoming.

sre-oncall: Handoff notes: rollback to stable image completed, traffic shifted to fallback model-v1, cordoned node gpu-03, core dumps uploaded to S3, initial suspicion: quantized attention kernel regression. No customer data loss. Next steps: deep kernel debug + repro + patch or pin kernel libs. Leaving monitoring at elevated sensitivity.

kiran: Incoming oncall acknowledged. Will follow up with nightly postmortem and propose a pre-deploy validation test for quant kernels.

ryan: I'll open the incident ticket in JIRA: INC-354321 and attach artifacts.

customer-success: Thanks team. Keep us posted and we'll update customers on next steps. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: Closing Slack loop here — bridge remains open for the engineers. If anything regresses ping page again.

devops-bot: Incident auto-update: status=mitigated, severity=high, responders=[sre-oncall,maya,kiran,ryan], link=jira/INC-354321
